action.objective: Commit the best-verified move from the shared-depth comparison, f4f5.
action.rationale: f4f5 wins the like-for-like depth-2 comparison (-34 vs +91 for a6a8) and its depth-2 exact score is better than a6a8's deeper -113. a6a8 was refuted by a steep drop (254) when Black plays Rb7a7. f4f5 creates a central pawn duo and its risk (Rxf5/Nxf5) costs only a pawn. a6a8 leaves the queen offside and vulnerable to the rook, so f4f5 is preferred.
